Name: mia's vanilla-friendly goblin and witch edits
Author: fantasyandmana
Description:
[left][b][size=5]requirements:[/size][/b]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]smapi[/url][/size]
[size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url][/size]

[size=5][b]description:[/b][/size]
[size=3]this mod replaces the vanilla henchman and witch art with versions i feel are less inclined to fantastical antisemitic bias. their noses are now smaller, and the witch is no longer bright green. i also gave them both shoes (why didn't they have them before...).[/size]

[b][size=5]compatibility:[/size][/b]
[size=3]compatibility has been introduced with stardew valley expanded & nyapu's portraits. see the files section.[i]
[/i][/size]
[b][size=5]recommended:[/size][/b]
[size=3]bea's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30784]dynamic golem rename
[/url][/size]
[b][size=5]note:[/size][/b]
[color=#cccccc][size=3]the contents of this mod are not intended to criticize or defame any person or entity. if you are interested in learning more about goblin/fairy tale folklore & its nuances, i recommend reading [url=https://jewitches.com/blogs/blog/goblins-jews-and-antisemitism-1?_pos=1&_sid=e75d491d6&_ss=r]this[/url] blog post as an informative starter. i, myself, am a gentile and would not feel equipped to speak of these issues in a manner that is wholly respectful.

please direct message me if you have any concerns.[/size][/color][/left]


[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/H3XR8Fr/blinkies-Cafe-7t.gif[/img][/center]
